status: PLACEHOLDER — researched from public cost guides (Oct 2026), not contractor quotes; verify before any real use

basis.scope: Each range prices one assumed job per bucket (see per-defect notes). Anchored to 2026 national/Baltimore/DC figures from Angi, Fixr, HomeAdvisor, This Old House, Olshan, Homeyou, then nudged up for DC-metro labor. Aggregator sources disagree; treat as planning numbers.
basis.roof: 1-2 flashing/sealant/few shingles; 3 section repair or major leak; 4-5 full asphalt tear-off and replace (MD avg ~$8.3k, VA $8-25k)
basis.chimney_fireplace: 1-2 cap/crown seal, small repoint; 3 repoint or crown rebuild; 4-5 flue liner replacement or partial rebuild
basis.gutters_downspouts: 1-2 reseal/rehang a section; 3 replace about half; 4-5 full seamless aluminum replacement with downspouts (200-300 ft at $9-18/ft)
basis.grading_drainage: 1-2 downspout extensions, soil fill; 3 regrade plus 50-100 ft French drain ($25-60/ft); 4-5 perimeter drain and regrade
basis.siding_exterior: 1-2 patch a few boards; 3 replace one wall section plus sheathing; 4-5 whole-house vinyl ($10-18k) to fiber cement ($16-30k)
basis.deck_porch: 1-2 fasteners, replace boards; 3 repair joists/railings (Baltimore repair avg $2.4k); 4-5 rebuild 200-300 sq ft at $35-65/sq ft
basis.walkways_retaining: 1-2 crack seal, reset pavers; 3 repair wall section or replace slab ($6-12/sq ft); 4-5 rebuild retaining wall (avg ~$8.8k)
basis.water_intrusion: 1-2 fix source, patch one spot; 3 repair ceiling/wall and source (typical $1.0-2.8k); 4-5 multi-room, framing or insulation replaced
basis.basement_moisture: 1-2 crack injection ($350-1.2k/crack), dehumidifier; 3 sump pump or partial drain; 4-5 full interior drain and sump (Baltimore avg ~$4.8k, up to ~$7k) or exterior membrane
basis.mold_mildew: 1-2 under 10 sq ft cleanup; 3 100-250 sq ft at $10-25/sq ft; 4-5 500+ sq ft or HVAC involved, plus rebuild
basis.foundation_structural: 1-2 hairline crack epoxy; 3 crack stabilization or 1-3 piers (DC avg ~$6.1k); 4-5 underpinning 8-12 piers at $1-3k each
basis.electrical: 1-2 outlet, GFCI, fixture, breaker; 3 rewire a few circuits; 4-5 partial rewire of old wiring (whole-house rewire exceeds this; no solid source found)
basis.electrical_panel: 1-2 breaker or minor panel work; 3 200A panel swap (DC avg ~$1.4k, 200A $1.8-3.0k); 4-5 panel plus service upgrade or recalled panel
basis.plumbing: 1-2 fixture or accessible leak; 3 in-wall leak ($350-1k) up to slab leak; 4-5 whole-house repipe (PEX $2.5-5.5k, copper $4.5-8k, older homes higher)
basis.water_heater: 1-2 valve, anode, element repair; 3 standard tank swap (installed $0.9-1.8k, MD avg ~$1.4k); 4-5 tankless or fuel switch with venting/gas line
basis.hvac_heating: 1-2 tune-up or small part; 3 blower, igniter board, heat exchanger-level repair; 4-5 furnace replacement ($2.8-6.8k nationally, DC higher)
basis.hvac_cooling: 1-2 recharge or capacitor; 3 coil or compressor; 4-5 central AC replacement (equipment plus install ~$5.5-10k)
basis.insulation_ventilation: 1-2 ridge or soffit vent fix ($300-1.2k); 3 attic top-up at $1-3/sq ft; 4-5 remove and replace, air seal, or vermiculite (removal $8-18k at the top)
basis.window_door_rot: 1-2 sill or one frame patch; 3 replace 1-3 windows ($565-1.2k each); 4-5 whole-house windows (12-16 at $9-12k)
basis.wall_ceiling_finishes: 1-2 patch and paint; 3 ceiling or wall section ($350-1.1k per repair, larger up to ~$1.8k); 4-5 multi-room
basis.flooring: 1-2 patch or refinish; 3 one room plus subfloor spot ($1.7-5/sq ft subfloor); 4-5 replace 800-1,200 sq ft at $6-15/sq ft, possible joist repair ($4-12k)
basis.stairs_railings: 1-2 tighten, repair (avg ~$790); 3 replace about 25 ft of railing (~$900-2.5k); 4-5 rebuild treads/stringers
basis.pest_wood_damage: 1-2 carpenter ant or spot treatment ($350-900); 3 liquid termite barrier ($1-3.2k) plus small repair; 4-5 structural carpentry ($3-15k)
basis.safety_alarms: 1-2 one or two hardwired units ($130-360 each); 3 3-6 units; 4-5 whole-house interconnected smoke and CO
basis.hazmat_suspect: 1-2 testing and encapsulation; 3 typical asbestos job (avg ~$2.1k, $1.2-3.0k); 4-5 vermiculite or large abatement ($5-20/sq ft)
basis.septic_sewer: 1-2 pump-out, camera inspection ($100-500), minor fix; 3 spot sewer repair (avg ~$3.3k); 4-5 full sewer line ($6-25k) or septic drain field/system
basis.fire_smoke_damage: 1-2 minor smoke and soot cleanup; 3 room-level fire and smoke restoration; 4-5 structural fire damage (national avg ~$20k, severe $30-50k)
